roles.title: Principal Software Engineer
roles.note: Transitioned from Cognizant Contractor to Pega FTE via negotiated management release to drive platform architecture for AU / global time zone enterprise operations.
highlights: Core JVM Runtime Architecture: Architected low-level Infinity Engine internals, including custom hierarchical class loaders, memory passivation algorithms, and lock-free concurrency, eliminating thread contention bottlenecks and sustaining 99.999% platform availability across global enterprise client deployments.

Cold-Start Elimination & Priming: Pioneered pre-emptive class-load priming at container startup, eliminating JVM cold-start latency spikes and enabling auto-scaled Kubernetes pods to handle peak production traffic immediately, cutting scale-up latency by ~85%.

3x Throughput Distributed ID Generator: Architected a distributed, batch-based unique ID generation engine across multi-tenant nodes, decoupling database locks and dependency bottlenecks to achieve over 3x throughput gains under peak concurrent workloads with zero collision risk.

Enterprise Data Privacy & PII Governance: Led engineering-wide PII data governance architecture (dynamic masking, cryptographic tokenization, access policy enforcement) across distributed engine logs and telemetry traces, ensuring zero sensitive data exposure and full enterprise compliance.

Unified Hashing Modernization: Spearheaded the consolidation of fragmented legacy hashing algorithms into a centralized, extensible cryptographic library, reducing future upgrade overhead by ~40% across distributed microservices.

High-Performance APIs & Connection Pooling: Engineered robust database connection pooling (HikariCP/custom adapters) and high-throughput RESTful integration APIs, hardening database resource recycling under high-concurrency failover conditions.

Incident Command & 30% MTTR Reduction: Served as Tier-3 Incident Commander and RCA lead for high-severity customer escalations; led systemic architectural remediations that slashed mean time to resolution (MTTR) by 30% alongside 24/7 mission-critical on-call production governance.

Engineering Multiplier & Quality Modernization: Chaired architectural reviews, authored technical RFCs, and modernized automated integration testing lifecycles with JUnit and Mockito, reducing regression cycles by 20% while mentoring senior engineers on JVM memory and concurrency patterns.

Core Engine SLA & Passivation Governance: Owned architectural enhancements for low-level passivation strategies, thread-pool allocation, and database connectivity, ensuring strict performance benchmark compliance and SLA adherence across multi-tenant enterprise accounts.

CI/CD & Deployment Acceleration: Architected end-to-end CI/CD release pipelines and automated regression test suites, cutting release cycle times by 35% and enforcing automated code quality gates across all contractor deliverables.

Systemic Incident RCA & 25–30% MTTR Reduction: Led cross-functional incident triage and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical enterprise production issues, engineering preventative runtime safeguards that reduced customer MTTR by 25–30%.

Developer Toolchain Modernization: Drove enterprise-scale developer infrastructure modernizations, including Vagrant-to-WSL2 environment migrations and Bitbucket-to-GitHub transitions, standardizing developer workflows and slashing engineering onboarding time by 50%.

Systems R&D & Patented Innovations: Led systems R&D, OS-level security hardening, and proof-of-concept initiatives, translating novel research into patented mobile security innovations and achieving feature parity across global flagship device lineups.

Test Automation Harness Architecture: Built comprehensive multi-threaded test automation and integration testing frameworks (UI Automator, custom device harnesses), accelerating Agile delivery cycles by 40% and elevating release stability.
